prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object visible, move to object, take object, check properties or scan area for objects. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = TakeObject    />         <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />     </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = MoveToObject    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO TakeObject
		ELSE
			DO CheckObjectProperties
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO MoveToObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObjects
	END
